newsitem.title: USA: BASEBALL-CARDINALS BEAT BRAVES TO LEAD SERIES 3-1.
newsitem.headline: BASEBALL-CARDINALS BEAT BRAVES TO LEAD SERIES 3-1.

text.p: Brian Jordan hit a home run in the bottom of the eighth inning and the St. Louis Cardinals rallied from three runs down to beat the Atlanta Braves 4-3 Sunday to move within one win of the World Series.
Jordan, who played football for the Atlanta Falcons from 1989-91, lined a 2-1 pitch from Greg McMichael over the fence in left-centre field for his second post-season homer.

Dennis Eckersley made it stand up, setting down the last three Braves in the ninth after Jermaine Dye led off with a double. He got pinch-hitter Luis Polonia on a popout to second baseman Luis Alicea and struck out pinch-hitter Terry Pendleton and Marquis Grissom.
The Cardinals have a surprising three games to one lead over the defending World Series champions and can wrap up the best-of-seven National League Championship Series Monday night in St Louis.
